description: This header file declares internal API function prototypes for Web Authentication Server Object, including functions for authentication request processing, credential verification, interface setting, and property management.

methods.name: WebAuthsoAuthenticateReq
methods.description: Handles authentication request processing for the Web Authentication Server.

methods.name: WebAuthsoVerifyCredential
methods.description: Verifies credentials within the Web Authentication Server context.

methods.name: WebAuthsoSetAcmIf
methods.description: Sets the Access Control Module Interface for the Web Authentication Server.

methods.name: WebAuthsoResetProperty
methods.description: Resets internal properties of the Web Authentication Server.

methods.name: WebAuthsoGetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves properties of the Web Authentication Server.

methods.name: WebAuthsoSetProperty
methods.description: Sets properties for the Web Authentication Server.
